items.source: Uses of ApplicationContextAssert.Scope in org.springframework.boot.test.context.assertj
Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。

items.source: Verifies that the application context does not contain any beans of the given type.
items.translation: 验证应用程序上下文不包含给定类型的任何 Bean。

items.source:
Obtain a single bean of the given type from the application context, the bean
becoming the object under test.
items.translation: 从应用程序上下文中获取给定类型的单个 Bean，该 Bean 将成为被测对象。

items.source:
Obtain a map bean names and instances of the given type from the application
context, the map becoming the object under test.
items.translation: 从应用程序上下文中获取给定类型的 Map 名称和实例，该 Map 将成为被测对象。

items.source: Verifies that the application context contains a single bean with the given type.
items.translation: 验证应用程序上下文是否包含一个给定类型的 Bean。
